This is an industrial area, and in figure 16 we made it quite clear. The point of impact of that projectile was about 130 metres away from residential buildings. We established that it was a very serious transformer station that was hit. Based on the crater and the appearance of the crater which left physical evidence that is recorded in figure 18, it was established that according to the experimental value which were plotted by Hunting Engineering Limited, the projectile in question was a bomb with solid explosive, FAB-100, and an impact fuse. When that sketch is placed in Google map or is superimposed on a Google map, we will see that there were some errors in determining the trajectory, and we have demonstrated that in figures 19 and 20. As a result, we have concluded the following --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: I apologise. Could you please tell us whose errors are that? Whose calculations errors are those?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC
utterances.text: Those errors that have to do with the marking of due north in the sketch of the impact site. In that specific case that area was 12.63. When all of that is added together --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we go to figures 19 and 20 and paragraph 39. Let's zoom in on the first two figures, and then we'll zoom in on the bottom one. Can you please tell us what you meant?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC
utterances.text: On the left-hand side you can see a Google Earth image where you can see the azimuth of the transformation station wall in Majdanska. It was 80.47. On the right-hand side is the sketch of the scene, and here we have determined the characteristic angles. The blew line is actual the same wall and we determined the characteristic angles that allowed us to calculate and conclude where exactly the trace was and how big its azimuth actually was. We determined that and the figure is 137.15. That calculation is given in here and it doesn't influence the result greatly, but it has to be made known that errors of that kind in determining due north on the sketches of the site were found in great numbers when we analysed the document -- documents that we had. In other words, we cannot conclude with great reliability based on the documents that we had at our disposal what the exact trajectory was. In any case, the bomb came from the south-east and the range was 100 to 150 degrees. As you can see, the direction would be in the direction of the transformation station, and we defined that transformation station as the most probably target of that bomb. Obviously, the distance of -- of the place of impact and the possible target is within the boundaries of one radial deviation.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, in view that this is an industrial zone and bearing in mind the transformer station, does that shed some light on the selection of targets and that this bomb actually target this objective?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC
utterances.text: Well, the bomb, we can claim, did actually hit the target, because as far as I remember, it did hit a high power line.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. How certain is it that this industrial zone was the target and not the settlement, the residential area? How far is the residential area?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC
utterances.text: Well, we did provide in figure 16 the industrial zone marked, and I believe that we did indicate that it was 130 metres, that the point of impact was 130 metres from the residential part of the town.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Could we now -- could I now refer you to case -- to case 13. That is the 6th of May, 1995. Incident 13. Could you tell us what the physical evidence suggests, what kind of conclusions, or what kind of conclusion does it impose?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC
utterances.text: That's paragraph 42?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Yes, paragraph 42, but we have to wait a moment for it to come up. Please go ahead.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC
utterances.text: Well, we cannot look at this case, this incident, without taking into account the ricochet that occurred on studio C -- that struck studio C of the TV building.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: That is incident 17, isn't it? That was deleted from the indictment, but -- or, rather, not from the indictment but from your report, well, from the indictment as well. But for the purpose of explanation, could you please take the liberty and tell us how this is related to that?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC
utterances.text: Well, you see, when analysing these two instances and in particular when we analysed the trajectories that were observed here in the -- in the case of this building where a projectile struck the roof of a five-storey building, the trajectory that was determined by the SJB and Mr. Zecevic, we shook that into account. Now, in view of the fact that we had at our disposal the incident involving a ricochet on the passageway, striking the passageway, these two were inter-related, and it was clear because in ricochet on the passage could in no way be connected -- be linked to the bomb that struck the TV building a month later. And then when we analysed precisely and accurately all of this, because we had these pictures and in our photo documentation, when we analysed the ricochet trail, I believe we have that in figure 26, we can see that it is consistent with the trajectory hitting the passageway, because it is directly on the same path, flying over the building at Safeta Hadzica Street 52. Now, we discussed here the possible ricochet directions and we concluded that this could be either a FAB-100 or a FAB-250 bomb in terms of its ballistics and characteristics of flight. We showed this in tables 4 and 4A, and the incident itself in the Safeta Hadzica street number 52 was -- is actually interesting. We did not agree with my colleague Zecevic because he pursued from a premise that is unacceptable in terms of the traces that were found, the effects on the target and the characteristics of aerial bomb with a solid charge.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could we see figure 26, please. In Serbian that's around page 80.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC
utterances.text: May I finish?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Let me just help you. In paragraph 50, if we can see figure 26. Could we show it to Dr. Subotic so that all involved can follow.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC
utterances.text: Well, I have it before me. Now, what happened in this incident. On that day a bomb ricochetted from a passage roof. The azimuth was determined in the expert report that analysed the ricochet and the targeting of the television building, and we determined that the direction was 323 plus/minus 3, and it was very clear because the passage roof was visible, and it was at a 90-degree angle.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: I apologise, but could we have figure 26. We have before us figure 23. Well, can we just see one of these. We just need one of them. We don't need 23. So could you describe what is this passageway and what kind of ricochet are we talking about? Where did the bomb come from, hit the passageway according to what you found, and then where did it ricochet to?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC
utterances.text: Well, to discuss this, we have to look at the part of the report relating to the television impact.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could you please just describe this image. What is number 1? What is number 3?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC
utterances.text: Well, I can, but that will not answer your question. I apologise. That will not constitute an answer to your question. I apologise, but let me do it. I'll do it in a minute. In Google Earth here we have the image of the part of the town where the TV building can be found as well as Safeta Hadzica Street number 52. Number 1 denotes the impact of the ricochet from the same air-bomb on the TV building. Now, the direction of flight that was determined when this was analysed, the strike on the TV, which you can find a little later in my report, was determined to be 232 plus/minus 3, and the trajectory was over -- went over the building in Safeta Hadzica 22, which is marked on this image with number 2. Now, the direction between 1 and 2 and the indication number 3, the marking for number 3, is the direction of the ricochet. Number 4, number 4 is the azimuth of 285, which was established by Berko Zecevic, which we showed to be incorrect in the second half of our report based on this image. And number 5 marks the police station where KDZ477 was. Why is this relevant? Well, Witness KDZ477 testified that he saw this air-bomb in flight. Later on, it was shown that he had claimed that this happened on that day and then on the day when the TV building was struck, actually, which was a month later. And then in the end he reverted to his original claim where in fact he was one of the persons who actually participated in the investigation of this incident involving the television building. That's why it's marked here.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Could you tell us now where in your report we can find these explanations for the incident in Safeta Hadzica Street number 52? What part of report is this described in, the ricochet?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC
utterances.text: Well, part explanation can be found in this part here on the next page from the page that we see before us. We checked the calculations, checking the height of the Y axis for FAB-100 and for FAB-250. Then we also checked the speeds after the ricochets, the velocities which -- for both cases, FAB-100 and 250, and also the ricochet for the angles between 5 and15 degrees. And all of these co-ordinates as we can see on the next page actually are consistent with the height of the trajectory in view -- in view of the height of the building.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could we see the next page so that we can understand what the witness is telling us. Is all the information in this chapter or can we find it someplace else?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC
utterances.text: Well, the trajectory information can be found in the part which discusses the incident involving the TV building where the angle of the ricochet was determined, which represents the azimuth of the point of impact on this building at Safeta Hadzica Street 52. This can be found, if you allow me -- just bear with me a moment. That's in paragraph 97 and figures 70 and 71.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Unfortunately, this incident was deleted or excluded, but I don't know if we can see this in e-court anyway, because this incident is related to this one, and there is -- we are -- we actually -- there's a certain prejudice as a result of this to our case. Now, could we show this image or perhaps we can show it on the ELMO. Okay. I see that it's all been redacted. The photograph too. Oh, well, then we'll have to take this up tomorrow. We will upload it in e-court and show it. We don't have to admit it into evidence if that is the Chamber's decision, but it can help understanding this better.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. President, I was wondering if the Chamber might reconsider its decision on the redaction of this incident given the link that has been made by the witness at this time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Is there any difficulty, if necessary, for Mr. Karadzic to separately produce the document?

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: To separately produce this particular image?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I'm not sure what it is about at the moment.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes, we can produce this image in a separate document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Given the time, shall we adjourn for today. Doctor, you will know that you are not supposed to discuss with anybody else about your testimony.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes. Yes, I do. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We'll continue tomorrow at 9.00, but in Courtroom I. The hearing is adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 14th day of May, 2013, at 9.00 a.m.
